evidence.quote: The Digital Management programme is entirely taught in English

Non-EU candidates who receive the letter of eligibility for enrolment in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program must complete the pre-enrolment procedure by logging in to the Universitaly portal and filling in the application online.

notes: Tuition: the programme page (apply.unive.it 593) states "Tuition fee €8,934 per year"; the programme's own tuition page for a.y. 2026/2027 states a maximum contribution of 8,726.00 EUR per academic year "without any distinction between Italian/EU students and non-EU students" (the 8,934 figure corresponds to no year shown on that page; the 8,606 EUR figure is for a.y. 2025/2026). The applied figure is therefore the 2026/2027 maximum contribution. Intakes: pages give "Studies commence 11 Sept 2026" and "Enrolment procedures generally begin in mid-July" / Universitaly pre-enrolment by 30 September 2026, but no dated non-EU application deadline was stated with a year, so no intake was output. Documents: the non-EU enrolment page (unive.it/pag/40976) lists bachelor's documents (Italian visa, Higher Secondary School final Diploma and transcript of records, Statement of Comparability/Declaration of Value/ARDI, language certificate) but these are quotes from a university-wide page and its lists mix optional/"highly recommended" items, so the documents fact was left out; likewise the apply.unive.it page's translation statement ("If your documents are not in English or Italian, please upload the original documentation or a verified copy of it AS WELL AS a professional translation in English or Italian.") is not tied to a named document list for this programme. | Owner-delegate decision 2026-10-05: tuition proposal REMOVED before verification. The only quote is a maximum contribution (a ceiling that depends on ISEE), not a fee a non-EU student living abroad is known to pay; Italian tuition stays unknown, as for every other Italian programme.

evidence.quote: A minimum B2-level knowledge of English is required. Please make sure you upload one of the certifications we recognise as proof of your English language level.
Applicants to bachelor's degree programmes must have completed at least 12 years of schooling and obtained a secondary school leaving qualification.

note.fr: Programme à admission limitée : un test d'entrée écrit en ligne (mathématiques et raisonnement) est obligatoire. Les candidats non-UE ayant besoin d'un visa doivent déjà avoir les résultats officiels d'un test d'entrée reconnu au moment de la soumission.
note.en: Limited-admission programme requiring an online written entry test (mathematics and reasoning). Non-EU applicants requiring a visa must already have their official results of one of the accepted entry tests at the moment of submission.

evidence.quote: This is a limited-admission programme that requires you to take an online written entry test that evaluates your knowledge of mathematics and reasoning.

Non-European applicants requiring a visa must take one of the recognized tests. These applicants must already have their official results of one of the accepted entry tests AT THE MOMENT OF SUBMISSION.

note.fr: Âge minimum : les candidats mineurs ne peuvent postuler que s'ils auront 18 ans au 31 décembre 2026.
note.en: Minimum age: underage applicants may only apply if they will turn 18 years old by 31 December 2026.

evidence.quote: Underage applicants are allowed to submit an application only if they will turn 18 years old by 31 December 2026.
